image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a rock beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, and golden yellow posterior body and tail. The eye is large and clear. The mouth is small with a visible orange line. The dorsal fin is visible along the top edge, and the anal fin is visible along the bottom. The tail is rounded. The background is a blurred coral reef environment.
